title.en: Li Mu’s frontier defence in the Shiji

summary.en: The Shiji describes Li Mu protecting frontier communities through warnings, shelter and cavalry training before drawing a Xiongnu force into an ambush. It reports heavy Xiongnu losses.
summary.zh: 《史记》叙述李牧先以烽火、收保与骑射训练保护边地，随后诱使匈奴军进入伏击，并记述匈奴遭受重创。

note.en: Recast the headline as an attributed primary-history narrative; checked sequence and meaning, not the independent accuracy of ancient totals. Inherited date and coordinates remain unchanged.

title.en: Li Mu defeats Huan Yi and receives the title Lord Wu’an
title.zh: 李牧击退桓齮，受封武安君

summary.en: The Shiji places Li Mu’s victory over Huan Yi after Qin had defeated Zhao’s commander Hu Zhe. Its figure of 100,000 dead belongs to that earlier Zhao defeat, not a force that Li Mu destroyed. The account then records Li Mu’s enfeoffment as Lord Wu’an.
summary.zh: 《史记》将李牧击退桓齮置于秦军击败赵将扈辄之后。所记“十万”死者属于前一场赵军败绩，并非李牧歼灭的秦军人数。传记随后记李牧受封武安君。

title.en: Li Mu’s removal before the fall of Zhao

summary.en: The Shiji attributes Li Mu’s removal to Qin bribes paid to Guo Kai and accusations of rebellion. Zhao’s king ordered a replacement, had Li Mu seized and killed, and dismissed Sima Shang. The narrative places Wang Jian’s decisive attack and capture of Zhao’s king three months later.
summary.zh: 《史记》把李牧被撤与秦方贿赂郭开、散布谋反指控联系起来。赵王命人替将，捕杀李牧，并废去司马尚；传记将王翦击破赵军、俘虏赵王记在三个月后。

summary.en: The Shiji contrasts Li Xin’s failed expedition with Wang Jian’s insistence on a larger force. Wang Jian waits behind fortifications before pursuing the withdrawing Chu army. The biography separates Xiang Yan’s defeat from the later capture of King Fuchu, rather than treating conquest as one battle.
summary.zh: 《史记》对照李信失利与王翦坚持增兵的两次出征。王翦先坚壁休养，楚军东撤后才追击；传记将项燕败亡与后来俘虏楚王负刍分开叙述，而非一次战斗即完成征服。

title.en: Huayang: Bai Qi’s victories and mass killing
title.zh: 华阳：白起获胜与大规模杀戮

summary.en: The Shiji records Bai Qi taking Huayang and defeating Mang Mao, followed by fighting Zhao’s Jia Yan. It reports 130,000 killed and another 20,000 drowned in the river. These are the historian’s reported totals, not independently counted losses.
summary.zh: 《史记》记白起攻取华阳、击败芒卯，随后与赵将贾偃交战；记述十三万被杀，另有二万人被沉入河中。这是史书所报数字，并非独立核算的损失。

context.en: This Qing portrait commemorates Li Mu, the commander whose training and defensive policy shape the frontier account.
context.zh: 这幅清代画像纪念李牧，即边防叙事中主持训练与守备的将领。

context.en: Li Mu’s composed pose and official dress belong to a Qing remembrance of the commander who received the title Lord Wu’an.
context.zh: 李牧沉静的姿态与官员服饰，属于清人对这位受封武安君的将领的追忆。

context.en: A Qing remembrance of Li Mu accompanies the Shiji’s account of his removal and Zhao’s final defeat.
context.zh: 清人追绘的李牧像，与《史记》中他被撤杀及赵国最终败亡的叙事并读。

context.en: The Ming inscription identifies Wang Jian as Qin’s great general. The portrait gives the named commander a place in later memory, while the Shiji provides the campaign sequence.
context.zh: 明代题字称“秦大将军王翦”。画像呈现将领的后世记忆，战役先后则依据《史记》叙事。

context.en: The Ming portrait names Bai Qi “Lord Wu’an of Qin.” Read this later honorific image alongside the Shiji’s account of conquest and mass killing.
context.zh: 明代画像题名“秦武安君白起”。可将这幅以封号纪念人物的后世图像，与《史记》中的征服和杀戮记载并读。

context.en: This Ming portrait names Sun Bin, the adviser in the Shiji’s Maling account: a later commemoration of the strategist.
context.zh: 这幅明代画像题名孙膑，是对《史记》马陵叙事中这位军师的后世纪念。

context.en: This 1893 illustrated-history image identifies Huan Wen, whose staff Xie An joined. It helps distinguish the two political figures; it does not depict the appointment in 360.
context.zh: 这幅1893年绣像历史作品标识桓温，即谢安入幕所事之人。图像帮助分辨两位政治人物，并不表现360年的任职现场。

Li Yu 李煜 is not Li Yuan 李渊 or Li Yuanhao 李元昊.
